summary: Smartbird, Inc. (formerly Allbirds, Inc.) filed an 8-K on August 19, 2026, containing a letter to shareholders from CEO Nadia Carlsten discussing business updates. The letter describes the company's transformation from a footwear retailer into an AI infrastructure provider, noting the sale of footwear assets, a name change, new leadership, and capital raise. The filing references results of discontinued operations included in the Q2 2026 quarterly report. No specific deal terms, stake percentages, prices, or advisor details are provided. The disclosure is routine corporate communication regarding ongoing strategic repositioning, not a distinct special-situation event with actionable terms.
